name: EventMate AI Event Assistant
author: devlinkros

sections.description:
EventMate AI Event Assistant adds a floating chat / wizard bubble to your public WordPress site. Visitors can describe an event, refine packages, and submit an intake request.

This plugin is an interface to the EventMate software-as-a-service. An EventMate account and widget publish token are required. The publish token is a public embed credential (stored in WordPress options and output on pages where the bubble loads) so the widget can start an intake session; it is not a WordPress admin password.

The widget only works on the website registered for your venue in EventMate (and its subdomains, such as events.your-domain.com).

External services

This plugin connects to the following external services. Nothing is sent until you save an API base URL and publish token under Settings → EventMate AI.

EventMate API

The widget is powered by the EventMate service. It is required for the plugin to work.

  • What is sent: when a visitor opens the bubble, the publish token is sent to start a session. While the visitor uses the widget, their answers (event type, date, number of guests, budget, wishes, chat messages) are sent to generate proposals. When the visitor submits a request, the name, email address, phone number and message they enter are sent so the venue receives the lead. The visitor’s IP address and browser user agent are recorded for abuse protection.
  • Where: https://api.event-mate.nl by default, or the API base URL you configure.
  • The “Powered by EventMate” credit is returned by the EventMate API as part of the service response; the plugin does not add any credit or link by itself.
  • Terms of service: https://app.event-mate.nl/algemene-voorwaarden
  • Privacy policy: https://app.event-mate.nl/privacy

Google Fonts

The widget loads the Onest typeface from Google Fonts for typography. When the bubble loads, the visitor’s browser requests the font stylesheet and font files from fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com, which shares the visitor’s IP address and user agent with Google.

  • Terms of service: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

PDOK Locatieserver (Kadaster)

Only for venues that offer catering at another location: when a visitor types the event address, the typed text is sent to the Dutch government PDOK Locatieserver (api.pdok.nl) to suggest and geocode addresses, so travel costs can be calculated. No other data is sent.

  • Service and terms: https://www.pdok.nl/
  • Privacy policy: https://www.pdok.nl/privacy

Source code

The bundled public/dist/eventmate-widget.js is compiled from the React/TypeScript sources included in the source/ folder of this plugin. A source map (eventmate-widget.js.map) is included next to the bundle.

To rebuild it from the source/ folder:

npm ci && npx vite build --config vite.widget.config.ts

The output is written to wordpress/eventmate-ai-event-assistant/public/dist/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/eventmate-ai-event-assistant (or install the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload) and activate it.
  2. In WP admin: Settings → EventMate AI, enter your publish token (API base defaults to https://api.event-mate.nl/api/v1; override only for staging or a custom API host).
  3. In EventMate, set the website URL of your venue. The widget accepts that domain and its subdomains.
  4. The chat bubble appears automatically on every public page. No shortcode.

The publish token lives in the EventMate dashboard under Widget / embed.
sections.faq:
Does this work without EventMate?

No. The plugin embeds the EventMate widget and requires a reachable EventMate API plus publish token.

Is the publish token secret?

Treat it as an embed credential: anyone who can view your public pages can see it in page HTML. It only works on your registered website. Rotate it from the EventMate dashboard if it is abused. Only users with manage_options can change it in WordPress.

I updated the plugin and the bubble is gone

Deleting the plugin in WordPress removes its settings, including the publish token. Paste the token again under Settings → EventMate AI. To update without losing settings, upload the new zip and choose “Replace current with uploaded”.

Can I turn the bubble off on some pages?

In this version the bubble loads site-wide on public pages once API base + token are set.
sections.changelog:
0.1.22

  • New: venues can ask the drinks question before the food question (dashboard setting “Drank eerst vragen”).
  • New: items priced per piece (e.g. sharing boards) get a quantity stepper on the ticket.
  • Fix: option descriptions are shown in full instead of being cut off mid-sentence.
  • Fix: a plain “yes” after the assistant offers a specific extra now adds that extra to the proposal.
  • Fix: the fixed drinks budget chip no longer collides with catering food options.
  • Fix: changing the guest count after proposals no longer shows a misleading “no lighter options” notice.

0.1.21

  • Fix: the “Stel je event samen” step fills the panel instead of a short card with an empty area below.

0.1.20

  • Fix: the wishes steps (“Stap 4 van 5”) fill the panel instead of a short card with an empty area below.

0.1.19

  • Fix: clicking an address suggestion fills in the location again, and the language and swap menus react to clicks inside the widget.

0.1.18

  • Fix: the guests and event-type sheets no longer get cut off or float halfway up the panel.
  • Fix: the date and location sheets stay inside the panel, so the calendar and Continue button are visible.

0.1.17

  • Admin notice on the Dashboard and Plugins screens when no publish token is set, so a missing bubble is easy to explain.

0.1.16

  • WordPress.org compliance: widget bundle loaded through the Script Modules API, bubble markup escaped on output, removed the temporary developer dashboard, external services documented, source code included.
  • The “Powered by” credit now comes only from the EventMate service response.
  • Requires WordPress 6.5 or newer.

0.1.15

  • Site-wide bubble enqueue on wp_enqueue_scripts so assets load before the footer markup.
  • Launcher hugs the intro card.
  • Embed origin must match the venue website; subdomains are allowed.

0.1.14

  • WordPress compliance hardening: text domain headers, URL sanitization, uninstall cleanup, LICENSE, launcher postMessage origin check.

0.1.13

  • Always show the bubble site-wide when API base + publish token are set.
  • Removed shortcode and “bubble on whole site” setting.
